chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us, he said: Abu Ahmad Abd al-Aziz ibn Yahya al-Basri narrated to us, he said: al-Mughira ibn Muhammad narrated to us, he said: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Azdi narrated to me in the year 216 AH, he said: Qays ibn al-Rabi and Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad narrated to us from al-A'mash, from al-Minhal ibn Amr, from Abbad ibn Abdullah, he said:

Ali (peace be upon him) said: No verse has been revealed from the Quran except that I knew where it was revealed, regarding whom it was revealed, regarding what it was revealed, and whether it was revealed on a plain or on a mountain.
It was said: Then what was revealed regarding you? He said: Had you not asked me, I would not have informed you.
This verse was revealed regarding me: "Surely, you are but a warner, and for every people there is a guide" [13:7].
The Messenger of God is the warner, and I am the guide to what he brought.

key_terms.آية: Verse -- a sign or verse of the Quran
key_terms.القرآن: The Quran -- the holy scripture of Islam
key_terms.منذر: Warner -- one who warns of divine punishment; here referring to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW)
key_terms.هاد: Guide -- one who leads to the right path; here referring to Imam Ali (AS)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about knowing the context of every Quranic verse?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) declares his comprehensive knowledge of every Quranic revelation -- its location, context, subject, and even the terrain where it was sent down. When asked about verses concerning himself, he cites Quran 13:7, identifying the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) as the "warner" and himself as the "guide" for every people. This narration was reported in a scholarly gathering in 368 AH and reflects the Shia understanding of the Imamate as divinely designated guidance alongside Prophethood.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (rh) narrated to us. He said: Abu Ahmad `Abd al-`Aziz b. Yahya al-Basri narrated to us. He said: al-Mughira b. Muhammad narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Muhammad b. `Abd al-Rahman al-Azdi narrated to me in the year 216 AH. He said: Qays b. al-Rabi` and Mansur b. Abi’l Aswad narrated to us from al-A`mash from al-Minhal b. `Amr from `Abbad b. `Abdullah. He said:

`Ali (as) said: No verse has been revealed from the Quran except that I know where it was revealed, regarding whom it was revealed, regarding what it was revealed, and whether it was revealed on a plain or on a mountain.
It was said: What was revealed regarding you? So, he said: Had you not asked me, I would not have informed you.
This verse was revealed regarding me: “Surely, you are but a warner, and for every people there is a guide” [13:7]
– the Messenger of Allah is the warner, and I am the guide to what he has brought.
